name: BeyondTrust Cybersecurity Glossary
description: BeyondTrust Cybersecurity Glossary — 53 terms focused on identity security, privileged access management (PAM), Active Directory security, and adjacent identity-first vocabulary. Tightly aligned with BeyondTrust's product portfolio.
relationToCloudSecurity: Direct — PAM/identity terminology fundamental to cloud security.
relationToAISecurity: Marginal — pre-AI identity vocabulary, though some entries (agentless security) intersect with AI ops.
